body:
I think it would be clearer to keep it as 'godot-editor' since 'godot-tools' might not clearly indicate that it refers to the editor.

Well, instead of changing the name, description can also be updated to clarify that it's for the editor build. Maybe: `Godot Engine Tools (Editor) Android Library.`

> I think it would be clearer to keep it as 'godot-editor' since 'godot-tools' might not clearly indicate that it refers to the editor.

I considered that but wanted to avoid giving the impression that the full `editor` module was available from `mavencentral`. 
Within the Godot c++ code, the logic we're making available is guarded under the `TOOLS_ENABLED` definition, and prior to Godot 4.x, [`tools`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/3.6/development/compiling/introduction_to_the_buildsystem.html#tools) was the term used for it. 

> Well, instead of changing the name, description can also be updated to clarify that it's for the editor build. Maybe: `Godot Engine Tools (Editor) Android Library`.

I've updated the description section to `Godot Engine Tools Android Library - Editor Build`

Listing all Godot developers here seems a bit unrealistic.

Couldn't we just have `Godot Engine contributors` with an email like `contact@godotengine.org`?
